ImageDescription.value:
A kind of cookie or candy very traditional from Mexico, it is a very simple baked preparation, made of vegetable fat, butter, wheat flour, roasted and ground peanuts, sugar and optionally vanilla.

Years ago you could find that candy or cookie anywhere in the CDMX, wrapped in colored "china paper", sold by people who carried baskets with different traditional sweets, almost always peanuts, milk sweets and eggs were the main ingredients of these sweets, this has now been somewhat lost, due to the widespread sale of processed products.

These breads are representative of the Viceroyalty period, specifically of the conventual pastry in Mexico.
